title: gleichenia nuda
intro: Gleichenia nuda, commonly known as the naked spleenwort or naked tree fern, is a species of fern in the family Gleicheniaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, particularly in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Gleichenia nuda are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gleichenia nuda include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
